title: Making Koopman Control Guarantees Hold on Robots
abstract: arXiv:2611.20402v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A Koopman controller can stabilize its learned latent-space linear model yet fail to stabilize the nonlinear plant. The learned model propagates predictions in latent space, while the deployed controller repeatedly re-encodes the measured physical state. We show that nominal closed-loop stability transfers to the nonlinear plant when the learned and true closed-loop dynamics agree to first order on the embedding's tangent space at the target. We derive a robustness margin for approximate matching and show that a stable open-loop latent model cannot exactly match an unstable equilibrium. We introduce Tangent-Invariant Koopman (TIK), which estimates a local plant linearization from offline transitions and enforces first-order matching to this estimate. TIK recovers the fitted LQR gain at the target, while a bilinear predictor captures state-dependent actuation during large maneuvers. Across four simulated unstable benchmarks, all 40 Stan

translated_title: 让Koopman控制的稳定性保证在机器人上真正成立
translated_abstract: Koopman控制器能够稳定其学习到的潜空间线性模型，却可能无法稳定真实的非线性被控对象。学习到的模型在潜空间中传播预测，而部署的控制器则反复对测量到的物理状态进行重新编码。我们证明了当学习到的闭环动力学与真实闭环动力学在目标点处嵌入的切空间上达到一阶一致时，标称闭环稳定性即可传递到非线性被控对象上。我们推导了近似匹配情形下的鲁棒性裕度，并证明稳定的开环潜模型无法精确匹配不稳定的平衡点。我们提出了切向不变Koopman（Tangent-Invariant Koopman, TIK）方法，该方法从离线状态转移数据中估计被控对象的局部线性化，并强制模型与之进行一阶匹配。TIK在目标点处能够恢复所拟合的LQR增益，同时双线性预测器在大幅度机动过程中捕捉状态相关的执行动态。在四个仿真的不稳定基准任务上，全部40个Stan……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出切向不变Koopman（TIK）方法，通过强制学习到的闭环动力学在目标点切空间上与真实动力学一阶匹配，使Koopman控制器的稳定性保证能够真正传递到非线性机器人系统上。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Tangent-Invariant Koopman (TIK), which enforces first-order matching between learned and true closed-loop dynamics on the embedding's tangent space at the target, ensuring that Koopman controller stability guarantees transfer to the nonlinear robot plant.
